title: cache.invalidate
description: Invalidates cached relations for specific issues or the entire project. Error kinds: config, unauthorized, http, not_found, invalid, transport, decode.

base_url.description: Plane API base URL (optional; omitted or equal to the configured PLANE_BASE_URL, or a loopback address only when the configured one is loopback; the API key is never sent elsewhere)

workspace.description: Plane workspace slug (optional, falls back to PLANE_WORKSPACE_SLUG)

project_id.description: Plane project ID (optional, falls back to PLANE_PROJECT_ID)

issue_ids.description: Issues whose relations changed; empty or absent clears the whole project cache
